{{Infobox auto}}

'''Glow berry jam''' is the preservation of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. It heals {{Value|Glow Berry Jam|heals}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 30 seconds, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Glow Berry Mash|Glow berry mash]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating glow berry jam takes {{Value|Glow Berry Jam|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Glow Berry Jam|heals}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/30s.mcfunction}}</ref> It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.5-alpha|Glow berry jam gives its glass bottle back when eaten.}}
{{History line|1.12.4|2=Glow berry jam made or found in this version gave no aura. It carries a <code>version</code> number in its custom data, and the advancement that starts the aura required the custom data to be exactly the aura marker.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/30s.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_jam.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.5|2=Fixed: the aura advancement only checks that the custom data contains the aura marker, so glow berry jam gives its aura again.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Glow Berry Jam and Mash fixed}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/30s.json}}</ref>}}
}}
